title: Booking a weekend cookery course
intro: Part 1. You will hear a man phoning a cookery school to book places on a course.

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: Good morning, Riverside Cookery School, Lucy speaking. How can I help?

segments.speaker: daniel
segments.text: Oh, hello. I saw your advert for weekend cookery courses, and I'd like to book a place. Well, actually, two places, if possible.

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: Of course. Let me open a booking form. Could I have your name, please?

segments.speaker: daniel
segments.text: Yes, it's Daniel Fenwick. That's F, E, N, W, I, C, K.

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: Thank you, Mr Fenwick. And which course are you interested in?

segments.speaker: daniel
segments.text: I was hoping to do the Italian course. My sister and I went to Rome last year, and we loved the food.

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: I'm sorry, the Italian course is fully booked until the autumn. But we've just added a new course on Thai cooking, and there are still a few places left. It's at a similar level.

segments.speaker: daniel
segments.text: Thai? Actually, that sounds great. We both like spicy food. Yes, let's go for the Thai course.

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: Lovely. Now, that course runs on Saturdays. The next available date is the 12th of June.

segments.speaker: daniel
segments.text: Hmm, the 12th is my sister's birthday, and she's already got plans for that day. Is there anything later in the month?

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: Yes, there's another one on Saturday the 21st. Would that suit you?

segments.speaker: daniel
segments.text: The 21st is perfect. Let's book that.

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: And you said two places?

segments.speaker: daniel
segments.text: That's right. At first I thought my brother might come too, which would make three, but he's working that weekend. So it's just two: me and my sister.

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: Fine. Does either of you have any special dietary needs? We cook with a lot of different ingredients.

segments.speaker: daniel
segments.text: I eat everything. My sister isn't a vegetarian, but she doesn't eat fish. She's never liked it.

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: No problem. Thai dishes often use fish sauce, but the teacher can give her something else instead. I'll make a note of that. Now, the price is £55 per person, so that would be £110 for the two of you.

segments.speaker: daniel
segments.text: Oh, I thought there was a discount. I get your monthly newsletter by email.

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: Ah, yes. Newsletter subscribers get £10 off the total, so it comes to £100. You can pay by card over the phone, if you like.

segments.speaker: daniel
segments.text: Yes, I'll do that in a moment. But can I just ask a few questions about the day itself first?

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: Of course. Go ahead.

segments.speaker: daniel
segments.text: What time does it start?

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: The kitchen opens at nine, and we serve coffee then, but the class itself begins at 9:30. It finishes at about four.

segments.speaker: daniel
segments.text: And do we need to bring anything? Knives, for example?

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: No, we provide knives and all the ingredients, and aprons too. But you'll cook far more than you can eat, so please bring a container to take the rest home. We used to give out paper boxes, but we stopped because so many were wasted.

segments.speaker: daniel
segments.text: Good idea. And is there parking near the school?

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: There's a supermarket car park opposite us, but it has a two-hour limit, so that's no good for a whole day. Use the car park behind the cinema instead. It's free on Saturdays.

segments.speaker: daniel
segments.text: Great. And finally, what happens if we need to cancel?

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: We used to ask for three days' notice, but we've changed that. Now you need to tell us at least seven days before the course to get a full refund.

segments.speaker: daniel
segments.text: OK, that's fine. Right, let me find my card.

questions.explanation: Daniel 逐个字母拼出 F, E, N, W, I, C, K。注意结尾是 ck，写成 Fenwik 判错。
他本想报意大利菜（Italian），但已经约满到秋天（干扰）；接待员推荐新开的泰国菜课，他同意了：let's go for the Thai course。注意首字母大写，拼写是 Thai。
最近的一期是 6 月 12 日，但那天是他妹妹生日（干扰）；改报 21 日。写 21、21st 或 twenty-first 都算对。
他起初以为弟弟也会来，那就是三个人（three 是干扰）；但弟弟那周末上班，所以只有他和妹妹两个人。

questions.prompt: Dietary needs: sister does not eat ___
questions.explanation: 妹妹不是素食者（排除 vegetarian 之类的答案），只是不吃鱼：she doesn't eat fish。后面提到的 fish sauce 是接待员说的处理办法，填 fish 即可。
每人 £55，两人 £110（干扰）；他订阅了邮件简报，总价减 £10，所以是 £100。题目已给出 £，写 100 或 £100 都算对。

questions.heading: On the day
questions.explanation: 厨房九点开门供应咖啡（nine 是干扰），课程本身 9:30 开始。写 9:30 或 9.30 都算对。

questions.prompt: Bring a ___ to take food home (knives and aprons provided)
questions.explanation: 刀、食材和围裙都由学校提供；做的菜吃不完，要自带一个容器（container）把剩下的带回家。学校以前发纸盒（paper boxes），现在不发了，是干扰。

questions.heading: Getting there
questions.explanation: 对面超市停车场限停两小时，不适合待一整天（干扰）；应该停在电影院后面的停车场，周六免费。

questions.prompt: Cancellation: at least ___ days' notice for a full refund
questions.explanation: 以前只需提前三天（three 是旧规定，干扰），现在要至少提前七天通知才能全额退款。写 7 或 seven 都算对。
